newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Group creditors end meeting without decision.
newsitem.headline: Kia Group creditors end meeting without decision.

text.p: Creditors of South Korea's Kia Group on Wednesday ended a meeting without decision after they had been expected to set a bail-out plan for the troubled group, a Korea First Bank official said.
Creditors decided that Kia officials were "not sufficiently prepared" to discuss the group's self-rescue plans and set another meeting for 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Friday, the official said.
Korea First Bank is the biggest commercial bank among creditors to the nation's eighth-largest conglomerate, which earlier this month was selected for bail-out by banks.
Another Korea First Bank official said earlier on Wednesday that the bank's proposal to extend 183.1 billion won in emergency loans to the group was also being discussed at the meeting.
